$Comment: What the server owes for the Scarak Brood Queen fight, which the fight's own script,
Server/EncounterManager/Sands_Brood_Queen_Encounter.json, never describes. Phases, thresholds,
the role changes, the brood and the boss bar all live in that script and in the three
Sands_Brood_Queen roles; nothing here restates them.
NameKey is the queen's own name, the same key her nameplate and her boss bar show, and it is
what a quest step naming this fight prints as its target. Subject names the script's Boss slot,
the one it binds her into.
Scale grows her maximum health with everyone in the fight: HealthPerMember 0.3 makes a party
of four fight a queen with 1.9 times the health of a solo one, and MaxHealthMultiplier 4 is
the ceiling however many pile on, so a crowd of twelve fights four times the pool and not
more. An open-world roster has no upper bound, which is why the ceiling is here.
Timing: a wipe is nobody in the roster (dead or walked off) for WipeGraceSeconds, and on an
open site that is a real wipe rather than a party three rooms away, so it is short. The script
stands the fight down a little after this and re-engages the wounded queen for the next party;
keep its stand-down Timeout at or above this number. MaxRunSeconds is left at the library's
default, an hour, which no party will reach.
Loot.OnDefeat is the fight's own payout, rolled once per credited participant with each roll
kept at a chance equal to that participant's share, so the player who carried the fight keeps
everything they win and a latecomer keeps a little. The table is
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/Mmo_Sands_Brood_Queen.json; retune it there. QueueIfOffline
holds a participant's payout for their next connect if they dropped before she fell. The quest
that names this fight pays its own reward on top when it is handed in.
Leaderboard writes every participant a row under the bucket, split by party size, with their
share as the score and the fight's length as the time. Feedback names the queen's own notices,
the four Sands_Brood_Queen_* files under Server/ZiggfreedCommon/FeedbackMoments, so she speaks
in her own words and no other encounter on the server borrows them. Discovery puts a world-map
marker over her from the moment she rises until the run resets, moving to her position every
FollowSeconds and still following while nobody is close (CompassUpdating), so a player across
the dunes can find the fight, and a quest step naming it shows the same glyph.
Participation is not authored: the library's own Zc_Default rule (damage dealt, damage taken
and time present, weighted) is the server rule and applies here as everywhere.
Switch the fight off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounters.json under
the key sands_brood_queen_encounter, and the library neither binds, scales nor pays this
script; /zigencounter reload re-reads that file live.
